author: Dick_Kickass
quote:
Legitimately unenjoyable. This isn't GTA at all. The limitations on play style are shocking. And the satire just isn't as sharp or edgy. GTA has become safe and politically correct, which is the actual antithesis of what GTA has always been.

The story is fine, the production value and detail are of course excellent, but that just isn't nearly enough to save the experience. 

GTA has always been the game that makes you say 'holy crap did they just say/do that' -- and that was the core of the appeal. The biting humor, the sharp satire, the caricature of every stereotype imaginable, the total lack of sacred cows. That was GTA.

This isn't it anymore. Really sad.
